If you go back far enough, everything li: At various points in evolutionary history, enterprising individuals within many different animal groups moved out onto the land, sometimes even to the most parched deserts, taking their own private seawater with them in blood and cellular fluids.
如果回溯足够久远，一切生命都曾生活在海洋中。: 在进化史的不同时期，许多不同动物类群中都有敢于探索的个体从海里走上陆地，有时甚至进入最干旱的沙漠。它们随身带着各自的那份“海水”，就在血液和细胞液里。

If you go back far enough, everything li: In addition to the reptiles, birds, mammals and insects which we see all around us, other groups that have succeeded out of water include scorpions, snails, crustaceans such as woodlice and land crabs, millipedes and centipedes, spiders and various worms.
如果回溯足够久远，一切生命都曾生活在海洋中。: 除了我们随处可见的爬行动物、鸟类、哺乳动物和昆虫，其他成功适应陆地生活的类群还包括蝎子、蜗牛、鼠妇和陆蟹等甲壳动物，以及千足虫、蜈蚣、蜘蛛和各种蠕虫。

If you go back far enough, everything li: And we mustn’t forget the plants, without whose prior invasion of the land none of the other migrations could have happened.

如果回溯足够久远，一切生命都曾生活在海洋中。: 从水生生活转变为陆生生活意味着需要彻底重新设计生活的方方面面，包括呼吸和繁殖方式。

If you go back far enough, everything li: Nevertheless, a good number of thoroughgoing land animals later turned around, abandoned their hard-earned terrestrial re-tooling, and returned to the water again.
如果回溯足够久远，一切生命都曾生活在海洋中。: 不过，还是有一些典型的陆地动物改变了主意，放弃了他们辛苦获得的陆地生存方式，重新回到了水中生活。

If you go back far enough, everything li: Turtles went back to the sea a very long time ago and, like all vertebrate returnees to the water, they breathe air.
如果回溯足够久远，一切生命都曾生活在海洋中。: 海龟很久以前就回到海洋，像所有脊椎动物重返水域一样，它们需要呼吸空气。

If you go back far enough, everything li: However, they are, in one respect, less fully given back to the water than whales or dugongs, for turtles still lay their eggs on beaches.
如果回溯足够久远，一切生命都曾生活在海洋中。: 然而，在一个方面，海龟比鲸类或儒艮更少完全回归水中，因为它们仍会在海滩上产卵。
